text: CNC-07 status: running normally, vibration within limits at last weekly inspection
CNC-12 status: running normally, spindle recalibrated last month
LATHE-03 status: running, coolant pump serviced last week
PRESS-02 status: running, hydraulic pressure nominal at 180 bar
ROBOT-ARM-5 status: running, axis encoders calibrated
CNC-07 manual: spindle bearing vibration above 4.5 mm/s at high RPM indicates bearing wear; replace bearing set SKF 7014 and re-balance the spindle
CNC-07 manual: if the spindle overheats above 75 C, stop the machine, check coolant flow and lubrication oil level before restart
CNC-07 manual: tool changer jam usually comes from a worn gripper spring; replace the spring and re-teach the tool positions
CNC-12 manual: axis backlash above 0.02 mm means the ball screw nut needs adjustment; run the backlash compensation routine
CNC-12 manual: alarm 1040 means spindle drive over-current; check the drive fan and the motor cable for damage
LATHE-03 manual: chatter marks on the workpiece come from a loose tool holder or worn chuck jaws; tighten and inspect jaws
LATHE-03 manual: coolant pump leak at the shaft seal requires lockout tagout before replacing the mechanical seal
PRESS-02 manual: hydraulic pressure dropping below 150 bar indicates a failing pump or an internal valve leak; inspect the relief valve first
PRESS-02 manual: never bypass the light curtain; a missing safety guard means the press must be locked out immediately
ROBOT-ARM-5 manual: encoder drift on axis 3 causes position errors; recalibrate using the reference pin procedure
ROBOT-ARM-5 manual: gripper pressure fault means the pneumatic line is leaking or the regulator is set below 5 bar
Plant safety rule: any smoke, sparks or burning smell means press the emergency stop and call the shift supervisor
Plant procedure: lockout tagout is required before opening any machine guard or electrical cabinet
Plant procedure: log every bearing, belt or seal replacement with the machine id and the part number
